product.name: x1
product.description: X1 is an AI app builder that guides an idea through focused questions, screen review, staged building and iPhone testing, then prepares App Store listing, screenshots and submission.

maker_first_comment.author: Manil Lakabi
maker_first_comment.text: X1 positions itself against one-shot app generation: it asks focused questions, maintains a connected plan and prepares App Store submission; a working prototype is free with no card required.

selected_comments.author: Gabe Moronta
selected_comments.text: Asked how X1 differs from Lovable's iPhone app, Replit and Claude/Codex.

selected_comments.author: Manil Lakabi
selected_comments.text: Said the differentiation is the process around code generation: questions, blueprint, scoped jobs, design, testing and a living plan rather than claiming a better model.

selected_comments.author: Muhammad Inamullah
selected_comments.text: Said X1 supports third-party services, with Supabase auth/database and OpenAI managed by X1, and described an agent that can discover and wire providers.

selected_comments.author: Rivendell Chorro
selected_comments.text: Asked about the hardest application types built with X1.

selected_comments.author: Muhammad Inamullah
selected_comments.text: Named on-device vision and live fleet/GPS routing as difficult cases because processing pipelines, live data and integrations must remain synchronized.

selected_comments.author: Boyuan Deng
selected_comments.text: Asked how X1 differs from Rork in practice.

selected_comments.author: Manil Lakabi
selected_comments.text: Described a product-team workflow: decide, design, build and test each piece while retaining linked product context.

selected_comments.author: Barnaby Lloyd
selected_comments.text: Asked how contradictory or unclear requirements are handled.

selected_comments.author: Manil Lakabi
selected_comments.text: Said X1 asks narrower questions for ambiguity and surfaces conflicts, assuming only cheap/reversible choices.

selected_comments.author: Muhammad Inamullah
selected_comments.text: Said X1 supports Apple Sign In and persistent per-user backend data, framing them as explicit product decisions rather than demo placeholders.
